newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto's youngest son says will get married.
newsitem.headline: Suharto's youngest son says will get married.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto's youngest son, a business tycoon who has attracted much controversy, said he will get married later this month, the official Antara news agency reported on Saturday.

Hutomo Mandala Putra, also known as Tommy Suharto, said on Friday he would marry 22-year-old Raden Ayu Ardhia Pramesti Rigita Cahyani, an Australian-educated descendant of the Mangkunegoro dynasty which once ruled Java.
The bride is also distantly related to Mandala Putra through his mother's family.
"It (marriage) is something normal in life," Mandala Putra told reporters in the city of Surabaya in East Java.
News about his marriage was reported by the Media Indonesia newspaper on Monday, which said preparations for the wedding on April 30 had been launched.
Mandala heads the Humpuss Group, which last year was awarded tax and tariff breaks by the government to manufacture a national car in collaboration with Kia Motors of South Korea.
Japan, the United States and the European Union have complained to the World Trade Organisation against the move, which they have labelled as an unfair trade practice.
Suharto has six children -- three sons and three daughters. Mandala Putra is the only one who is still single.
